title: fix(spec)!: composeStacks refuses an object name a package body declares beside another declaration of it, under every objectConflict strategy
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgY7pZm8QgrtP2rHCwcDhXAb)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`composeStacks` 合并对象时，只要某个对象名落在合成产物的某个包体里（嵌套产物自带的包体，或 `manifest: 'preserve'` 下由带 manifest 的输入组装出的包体），而另一个输入也声明了同名对象，`objectConflict` 取 override 或 merge 也一律拒绝，返回 422 `STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT`，提示改名、用 `objectExtensions`，或在默认 manifest 下平铺合成。
- 为什么改：实测（真实启动）这三种组合在 override/merge 下都能合成，但启动时要么报 `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME` 拒绝，要么只认包体里那份对象、把另一份声明（覆盖结果或合并出的字段）静默丢掉；override 没覆盖、merge 没合并。
- 风险与回滚：收窄，BREAKING（`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`）。上述组合由「合成成功、启动失败或静默丢失」改为合成时 422；默认 manifest 下的平铺输入判法与输出完全不变，`error` 模式的报错文字不变；第一方普查 0。只改 spec 里一个私有函数，回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `refuseNestedBodyObjectConflicts`（`inBody` 判定、`claimed` 不再以顶层为种子）；`packages/spec/src/compose-stacks-manifest-preserve.test.ts` 里由「合并后保留扁平副本」改为「拒绝」的那条用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/compose-stacks.test.ts src/compose-stacks-manifest-preserve.test.ts`，预期全绿；新 describe 下 shape 1/2/3 的 8 条拒绝用例在 `main` 上为红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32516

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `composeStacks` answers, under `objectConflict: 'override'` and `'merge'`, FROM composed TO refused `422 STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT` for three compositions: (1) an input carrying `packages[]` whose package body declares an object name its own top level also carries (an additive nested artifact), beside another input declaring that name, under either manifest; (2) under `manifest: 'preserve'`, two inputs with a manifest that both declare one object name; (3) under `manifest: 'preserve'`, an input with a manifest beside a manifest-less input declaring the same object name. Measured before, through a real boot: each either refused at boot (`DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME` 422, two bodies) or booted the body's copy and silently dropped the other declaration. First-party census: 0 (`git grep objectConflict` outside `packages/spec/src`: the three hits are the two runtime test fixtures adjusted here and one comment in `examples/app-multi-package`, which composes two disjoint packages under the default strategy). `'error'` and every composition with no package body are unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed — no key, value or schema shape moves; what an author can compose narrows as above. The output of every admitted composition is unchanged.
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names `composeStacks` only as an existence pointer (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`) and teaches no object-conflict rule; `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` says duplicate object names throw unless an `objectConflict` strategy is passed, for a default-manifest flat composition, which stays true. The prescription ships in the refusal text.

## Why

`composeStacks` reconciles same-name objects through `objectConflict`, but only at the top level of its inputs. A package body is carried as it is: a nested artifact's bodies untouched, and under `manifest: 'preserve'` each input with a manifest is assembled into a body of its own objects. At boot a package body's declaration stands over the artifact's top-level one (the metadata plugin registers bodies through `resolveArtifactPackageOrder`). So whenever one name sits in a body and is declared again beside it, `'override'` overrides nothing and `'merge'` merges nothing: the boot refuses the second body, or keeps the body's copy and drops the reconciled one. PR #32495 (card #32477) refused this for a body name its own input's top level did not carry; this refuses the remaining shapes its contract review escalated (6811982973 ③ 1 and 2), plus a third of the same family found in step 0.

## Step 0 — measured on `main` e5428312 through a real boot

Rig: seat 3's #32477 boot harness (`MetadataPlugin` local-file artifact, `ObjectQLPlugin`, `AppPlugin`, sqlite), temporary and never committed. `p1` and `q` co-own namespace `alpha` and both declare `alpha_shared_thing`; `m` is a manifest-less stack; `N1` = compose(`p1`, manifest-less) under `'preserve'` (one package entry, top level kept beside `p1`'s body); `N2` = compose(`p1`, `p2`, manifest-less) under `'preserve'`.

| shape | strategy / manifest | compose (main) | boot (main) |
|---|---|---|---|
| every shape | `error`, either | REFUSED `STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT` (top-level walk) | — |
| 1 `N1`+`q`, `q`+`N1`, `N2`+`q` | override or merge / preserve | composed, bodies `p1{X}` + `q{X}` | REFUSED `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME` 422 |
| 1 `N1`+`q`, `N2`+`q` | override / default | composed, top `X` = q's | booted `p1`'s body `X`; q's override gone |
| 1 `q`+`N1` | override / default | composed, top `X` = p1's | booted `p1`'s `X` (the cell #32477's ruling A already refuses for the stripped artifact) |
| 1 either order | merge / default | composed, top `X` merged | booted `p1`'s body `X`; the merged fields gone |
| 2 `p1`+`q`, `q`+`p1` | override or merge / preserve | composed, bodies `p1{X}` + `q{X}` | REFUSED `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME` 422 |
| 3 `p1`+`m`, `m`+`p1` | override or merge / preserve | composed, body `p1{X}`, top `X` = m's or merged | booted `p1`'s body `X`; m's declaration or the merge gone |
| CONTROL 2 and 3 | override or merge / default | composed | booted the composed `X` |
| CONTROL `N1` + another object | preserve / default | composed | booted |

Refuse, not reach into the bodies: under `'preserve'` installing `p1` then `q` refuses `q`'s claim on the name (#32477 step 0), so moving or folding one body's object into another would compose what two installs refuse; under the default manifest it would rewrite a nested package's body with another input's object. Refusing matches #32477's ruling A and the remedies its refusal text already gives.

## What changes

- **`refuseNestedBodyObjectConflicts(stacks, preserve)`** (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, private): each declaration carries `inBody`. A nested artifact's body declarations are noted even when the input's own top level carries the name (the `claimed` set no longer starts from the top level); under `'preserve'` the top-level objects of an input with a manifest and no `packages[]` count as in a body, the same test `preservePackageEntries` applies. A name with at least one in-body declaration, declared by two distinct inputs, is refused with the existing `StackComposeObjectConflictError` (422 `STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT`). Issue lines keep #32495's spelling: a flat site stays `stack.objects[J]` with no holder suffix, so every existing pin's issue text is unchanged; an additive input lists both its top-level and its body site.
- **Refusal message**: the header reads "declared in a package body of the composed artifact and by another input", and the explanation says a body's declaration stands over any other at boot. The three remedies are unchanged.
- **`mergeObjects(stacks, strategy, preserve)`** forwards the manifest choice; `composeBuiltStacks` passes `opts.manifest === 'preserve'`.
- Doc comments made true again: the `refuseNestedBodyObjectConflicts` docblock (its "top level claims a name over its bodies" premise was falsified by the measurement), the `composeStacks` jsdoc's **Objects** paragraph, condition 3 of the `manifest` option's jsdoc, and `packagesReproduceComposedCollections` (two packages' reconciled object no longer reaches the strip; the sibling-action bind still does). Prose only, no `.describe()`.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/compose-stacks.test.ts`, new describe "an object name in a package body is refused beside another declaration under every strategy" (14 cases):

- shape 1: additive nested input + `q`, `override` and `merge` × both manifests × both orders, refused with the exact issue;
- shape 2: flat `p1`+`q` under `'preserve'`, both strategies, both orders, refused;
- shape 3: `p1` + a manifest-less input declaring the name under `'preserve'`, both strategies, both orders, refused;
- CONTROL: shapes 2 and 3 under the default manifest still compose into one object (override: the later; merge: both fields);
- CONTROL: under `'error'` every shape is refused by the top-level walk with its own issue, either manifest;
- CONTROL: an additive nested input beside a package declaring another object composes, output unchanged.

The #32477 describe is untouched except one title, which now says "under 'error'" (its body runs only `'error'`).

Moved pins (fixture triage: each pinned the composition this PR refuses):

- `packages/spec/src/compose-stacks-manifest-preserve.test.ts` "keeps the flattened copy when `objectConflict: '%s'` RECONCILED two packages' object" → "refuses two packages' same-named object under `objectConflict: '%s'` instead of reconciling it" (`STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT` 422, and the default-manifest control still reconciles). The `bodiesReproduceFlattened` helper drops its unused strategy parameter; it is still asserted in both directions (disjoint → true, the sibling-action bind → false).
- `packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.test.ts` "#14512 — what the EMITTER hands this reader…" now asserts the emitter refuses that pair; the hand-built reconciled artifact above it still pins the reader.
- `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.test.ts` "objectConflict $conflict: the reconciled object's action is bound once…" builds the same artifact by hand (the reconciled object at the top level beside both bodies, the shape an artifact already on disk carries) instead of through `composeStacks`; its assertions are unchanged.

<details><summary>Red first, green, ablation</summary>

- Red on `main` + pins (35de7adf): `Tests 8 failed | 63 passed (71)` in `compose-stacks.test.ts`, exactly the 8 shape 1/2/3 refusal cases; every CONTROL green.
- Green: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → `Test Files 835 passed | 1 skipped (836)`, `Tests 26722 passed | 1 skipped | 1 todo (26724)`.
- Ablation (once, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, through the verify lock, at 53ce9801): anchor `    const claimed = new Set<string>();` → `    const claimed = new Set<string>(topLevel);` (main's exemption put back; x1 → x0, blob e9f720680acf → 4b776c138dbc): `Tests 4 failed | 67 passed (71)`, the four shape 1 cases red; restored, blob == HEAD e9f720680acf, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite imports `./stack.zod` from `src/`, so no build leg.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- One cell of shape 1 booted what `'override'` intends today: the additive input composed LAST under the default manifest (its top level and its body agree). It is refused now, as #32477's ruling A refuses the same cell for a stripped nested artifact.
- `examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts`: one comment sentence said `'merge'` / `'override'` fold two packages' same-named objects under `'preserve'`; it now says that pair is refused. No code change there.
- `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` ("Duplicate object names throw unless you pass an `objectConflict` strategy") describes a default-manifest flat composition and stays true.
